{{Removed|date = 29th of October 2020}} {{for|[[Winter Bridges]]|[[Winter Abyss]]|[[Classic Winter]]}} {{MapInfobox |image1 = |-|Icon = [[File:WinterIcon.png]] |-|View = [[File:WView.png]] |developer = ''2ⁿᵈ'' - Cyclxnee
''1ˢᵗ'' - Beefchoplets |length = Short |wave_structure = Normal |music-1 = '''Ambient''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Frost Solitude|250px|thumb|center]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Winter''' was, as the name suggests, a winter [[Maps|map]]. It was remade once before it was removed and then replaced by [[Winter Abyss]]. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Version 2 |The second version of '''Winter''' took place at night on a winter island. The island was surrounded by a frozen sea. There was very little evidence of human habitation apart from the huts. A low lying frozen river flowed through the map into a frozen lake. Large and small snowy trees could be seen dotted around the map. The brown path began and ended at two snow caves. The path took a long straight before doubling back on itself twice. The path went over the river three times, once over some rocks and twice over a wooden slabs. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Winter ''' took place during the day. The map was surrounded by a white expansive baseplate. On the map, there were five snow mounds that you could place cliff towers on. There were some winter trees dotted around the map with two small rural homes near the path. The brown path began and ended at two snow caves at two of the snow mounds. The path took a long straight before doubling back on itself twice. }} ==Strategy== *The place where the path twists is where most ground towers should be placed to maximize a tower's range. **Bear in mind that you cannot place towers on the frozen river that runs through this map. *While there are optimal spots for cliff towers, there are few cliff spots in general. Try to limit the reliance on cliff towers on this map. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} Winter.png|First version (14 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) {{GalleryHeader|View}} Winte.png|First version (14 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Development Videos}} Commander Development Video - Tower Defense Simulator|First version on a development video. }} ==Trivia== *Like other dark-themed winter maps, like [[Winter Stronghold]], ''Frost Solitude'' played on this map. *During [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], '''Winter''' had an {{Color|Easy}} difficulty. ==Update History== *'''14 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.0|BETA v1.0.0]] **'''Winter''' added. *'''2 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.7|BETA v1.7.0]] **Difficulty changed from {{Color|OldNormal}} to {{Color|OldEasy}}. *'''5 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.8|BETA v1.8.0]] **{{Color|OldEasy}} difficulty removed. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Winter''' remade. *'''11 February 2020''' - [[Release v1.7|Release v1.7.0]] **Frost Solitude music added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Winter''' removed and replaced by [[Winter Abyss]]. {{MapNavBox}}
